arguments.title: Alex — 2028 Cross-Service Architecture Review Bio
arguments.body: Alex is a Staff individual contributor at Sphere, focused on cross-service architecture across infrastructure and platform systems, including the metrics pipeline, Cardinality Guardrails, and Lantern. Alex defines shared technical invariants, examines failure modes and provenance, and makes ownership and escalation boundaries clear so teams can coordinate safely across service seams. Mapped service owners retain responsibility for implementation, release, rollback, and day-to-day operations; Alex’s role is bounded technical review and reusable evidence, not centralized approval or people management.
